reasons.typo: This domain looks like a typo and can’t receive mail.
reasons.shared: This is a shared team inbox, so it may not reach one person.
reasons.mailbox: The domain is real, but this mailbox doesn’t exist.

items.q: Is the free check really free?
items.a: Yes. You get 10 checks a day with no login and no card.
No. Granska asks the mail server if it would accept the address, then disconnects before anything is sent.
Most checks give a clear answer, but some mail servers refuse to say or accept every address. When that happens we show Risky or Unknown instead of guessing.
The address will probably receive mail, but there’s a catch: it could be a throwaway inbox, a shared team inbox, or a server that accepts everything.

items.q: Can I use it in my app?
items.a: Yes. The Pro plan includes a Developer API for checking addresses from your forms and tools.
